title: Holy Week at Emmanuel
deck: Walk the way of the cross with us, from the triumph of Palm Sunday to the joy of Easter morning.
summary: Walk the way of the cross with us, from Palm Sunday through to the joy of Easter morning — with services held jointly at Emmanuel and St Cuthbert's.
lede: The heart of the Christian year — the journey with Christ through his Passion, death and resurrection.
body: Holy Week takes us with Jesus from the triumph of Palm Sunday, through the Last Supper and the cross of Good Friday, to the empty tomb on Easter morning.

Services are held jointly between Emmanuel and St Cuthbert's churches. The full schedule for each day — Palm Sunday, Daily Mass, Maundy Thursday, Good Friday and Easter Sunday — is shown on the poster.
All are welcome at every service. Do come and keep these holy days with us.
